sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Dainty Bracelet Combo Set – Minimalist Pearl Strand & Textured Link Chain
sourceNotes.rawContent: Refresh your accessory collection with this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Combining a classic pearl strand with a modern textured chain, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To maintain its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely after every wear.
